cameras.name: Cam 1 - Lobby
cameras._deterrence_comment: Probed 2026-10-20: Xiongmai IPC_GK7205V500_G5SF. Driver 'whitelight' blinks the camera's OWN built-in white-light LED as a strobe via the XMeye/Sofia DVRIP protocol (port 34567, Camera.WhiteLight WorkMode Open/Close) - no external hardware needed. NOTE: that LED is NIGHT-ONLY (schedule 18:00-06:00 + dark-scene gated), so the strobe shows after dark - which is when after-hours intrusions happen. Alternatives: 'onvif' pulses ONVIF relay RELAY_OUTPUT_000 (port 8899, monostable) for an EXTERNAL siren/strobe on the alarm-out; no ISAPI; no speaker (AudioOutputs=0). See deterrence.py / scripts/probe_camera.py.
